description: This file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for periodically sending system presence information (like IP address, app version, input activity) to a control channel, and enabling immediate reports. It includes methods to start and stop reporting, compose status summaries, and retrieve environment details.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for periodically sending system presence information.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic presence report task if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing presence report task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Assembles environment info and sends a system event to the control channel, optionally with a specified reason.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Triggers an immediate presence report with a default or specified reason.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a textual summary of the current presence state for reporting.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the app version string, combining bundle version info.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the operating system version.
